links.outcome: Flesch reading ease and grade level of ChatGPT versus Google responses
links.effect: ChatGPT and Google both difficult to read (Flesch 33.1 vs 37.0, p = 0.180) and at a college level (14.3 vs 14.2, p = 0.820).
links.quote: According to the Flesch reading ease scale, ChatGPT and Google sources were both considered similarly difficult to read (33.1 vs 37.0, p = 0.180) and at a college level (14.3 vs 14.2, p = 0.820.)

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT patient education answers
links.effect: ChatGPT responses at college reading level (grade 14.3), Flesch 33.1, as difficult as Google sources.
links.quote: According to the Flesch reading ease scale, ChatGPT and Google sources were both considered similarly difficult to read (33.1 vs 37.0, p = 0.180) and at a college level (14.3 vs 14.2, p = 0.820.)

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and readability of ChatGPT-4 responses to head and neck cancer patient questions compared to Google search results, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
